content:
Omar: Preparing to promote RC rc-serving-v2.7.0 to prod in 30m. This includes runtime optimizations and quantized weights. Plan: canary -> region rolls -> quiet window.

Lina: Artifact pinned: ghcr.io/redwood/serving:sha-0a1b2c3d. Model weights pinned to model-v2-q4. KV migration: none.

Beth: Double-checked release notes (latency improvements, fallback tweaks). We should add a canary-only debug log gate so we can increase log level if we see odd errors.

Omar: Good idea. Adding gate: ff.serving_debug -> canary_only. Ramp plan: canary 5% internal (5m hold) -> us-central (25% -> 100% with 3m holds) -> eu-west (10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m holds). Quiet window 20m after last region.

Deploy-bot: Promotion queued by omar for rc-serving-v2.7.0. Pipeline: e2e smoke -> canary -> regional ramps.

Deploy-bot: Canary passed smoke (4/4). Enabling canary traffic 5% internal.

Lina: Canary smoke good. p95 down ~30ms. No obvious error increase. Enabling ff.serving_debug for canary.

Sre-oncall: Monitoring traces and CPU. If error rate >1% for 2m or p95 increases >40% revert. Deadman abort if queue depth > 5k for 2m.

Beth: +1 from me. Leave logs on for 15m only.

Omar: Explicit +1 from @lina and @beth to proceed to us-central?

Lina: +1 :thumbsup:

Beth: +1 :rocket:

Deploy-bot: Starting us-central ramp: 25% -> 100% (3m holds).

Sre-oncall: us-central metrics green. No queue spikes.

Deploy-bot: us-central at 100%. Rolling to eu-west now with staged ramp.

Deploy-bot: eu-west 10% -> 50% (5m hold).

Sre-oncall: eu-west p95 rose 12% during 50% hold but within threshold. continuing.

Deploy-bot: eu-west -> 100%. Promotion complete. Quiet window (20m) active.

Beth: Release notes posted and runbook updated with rollback snippet.

Omar: Rollback snippet: "kubectl -n serving set image deploy/serving-service serving=ghcr.io/redwood/serving:sha-ff998877" and flip feature flag ff.serving_debug=false.

Sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll run post-promo sweep at quiet window end and post results.

Lina: Nice work. I'll close this thread after the sweep if all clear.
